messages:
maria (CSM): FYI — FlorinAI pilot tomorrow 10:00-14:00 UTC. They want provisional egress CIDR + geo-fallback to APAC if EU capacity hits 90%. Also asked for a 1-hour burst window (10:30-11:30) and auto-revoke after 4 hours. Renewal flagged in 30d due to past throttles. Can ops provision and doc steps for the customer?
ben (EdgeOps): Can do. Need the exact CIDR(s) or will you share an IP set? What's the proof window? I'll propose a /28 ephemeral CIDR unless they supply static IPs.
sam (Infra): Also need routing policy: do they want region-pref routing or strict failover? If failover, we can set routing policy policy=failover, primary=eu-west, fallback=apac; sample config below.

sam (Infra): ```yaml
routing:
  policy: failover
  primary: eu-west-1
  fallback: apac-southeast-1
  health_threshold: 90 # percent capacity
``` 
sam (Infra): For rate window, we can apply a temporary rate increase rule scoped to the customer token and CIDR with TTL.
aisha (Enablement): I'll prepare a short checklist for the customer: 1) verify CIDR reachability 2) SSO auth flow smoke 3) token rotation test 4) synthetic load test (we'll provide a lightweight harness). Want this in a shared doc and a runbook for the demo.
maria (CSM): Sending customer CIDR now — they supplied a stable NAT range: 203.0.113.32/29. Requested burst 10:30-11:30 UTC and auto-revoke at 14:30 UTC. Also they want per-minute QPS bump to +150% during window.
ben (EdgeOps): Got it. I'll provision ephemeral CIDR entry for 203.0.113.32/29 in edge ACL, create a temp rule: scope=tenant:florinai token=* cidr=203.0.113.32/29 qps_multiplier=1.5 starts=2024-05-12T10:30:00Z ends=2024-05-12T11:30:00Z auto_revoke=2024-05-12T14:30:00Z
ben (EdgeOps): Also enabling prefix/KV cache pre-warm for their demo to reduce latency. :rocket:

deploy-bot: Rule created: prod-edge-acl/ephemeral-florinai-203.0.113.32-29 (expires 2024-05-12T14:30:00Z) — ID r-78e2
sam (Infra): I'll add canary routing test steps and a quick curl example for their engineers:

sam (Infra): ```bash
# test primary
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/generate?region=eu-west-1" \
  -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'
# force fallback by simulating high load header
curl -H "X-Debug-Force-Fallback: 1" ...
```
aisha (Enablement): I'll upload the checklist and the step-by-step demo runbook to the shared drive and ping FlorinAI with pre-demo run times. Also flagging renewal team — note: if throttles persist post-demo, we may need to offer a short Dedicated trial.
maria (CSM): Thanks team. I'll update the ticket and include the renewal risk note. I'll post customer confirmation when they test. :white_check_mark:
